items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: And there was also a girl (chorus) named Betty who had been a girl friend of Lincoln Mills, the trumpeter I had worked with in Benny Carter's orchestra.

ctx.x: The Cotton Club Show left for England and Willie Lewis' band left for another summer season in Knocke, but George Johnson did not go with the orchestra. I suppose that Willie had engaged him only for the Ambassador job. It was only during engagements at the summer resorts such as Knocke and Ostende that Willie Lewis' orchestra played tea dances or matinees every day. But it was a pleasure to work in the best Negro orchestra in Europe and although we stayed up late most every night, I and some of the other…

Ray Ventura was the leader of the biggest French jazz orchestra in France and he was engaged to play upstairs in the large hall of the Kursall. Ray had an orchestra of about 16 or 17 musicians and an American girl singer whose name I remember as being Betty. Ventura had a real show band, but he also had the best musicians in Europe from different countries. One outstanding musician in the orchestra was a French trumpet player named Philippe Brun.
